newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nam Fatt steady on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nam Fatt steady on requotation.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian construction concern Nam Fatt Bhd were steady on requotation following a one-week suspension.
Around 0210 GMT, the stock was unchanged at 8.55 ringgit on volume of 1.31 million traded.
The company made three separate announcements since being voluntarily suspended on September 12.
It announced a proposal for a one-for-one bonus issue and said a proposed private placement of 8.04 million new shares had been approved by the Securities Commission and Foreign Investment Committee.
Nam Fatt also said it was proposing to buy two Thai companies for 14.47 million ringgit which will give the firm a stake in a planned resort in Phang Nga province.
